name: The Home Depot

window.note: Most items, with proof of purchase.

outcome.note: Store returns are credited at the time of return; the form of the credit wasn't confirmed.

conditions.value: Most items within 90 days with proof of purchase. Furniture, gas-powered tools, TVs, computers, paint sprayers, tractors and framing and roofing compressors: 30 days, unused in original factory-sealed packaging. Gas generators: 7 days.

processing.value: About 7 business days to process, then up to 10 business days for your bank

categories.label: 30-day items
examples: Gas-powered trimmers, blowers, chain saws, mowers and tillers

categories.label: Gas generators (not whole-house or stationary)
categories.note: Another Home Depot page says 30 days; the shorter 7 days is used.

value.without: Stores can look up the purchase with the debit, credit or gift card or check used: within 90 days for check, credit or debit, or 365 days for Home Depot credit cards.

timing.value: About 7 business days to process, then up to 10 business days for your bank

methods.label: Return at a Home Depot store
steps: Bring the item to the store's Service Desk
For online orders, bring the shipment confirmation email or the card you paid with
methods.note: Credit is issued at the time of return.

methods.label: Mail it back
steps: Start the return from your online order
methods.note: Credit is issued after the warehouse receives and processes it. Items that use flammable fuel can't be mailed.

unknowns.note: Home Depot pages disagree (7 vs 30 days). The shorter window is used.
Whether store returns refund to the original payment wasn't confirmed.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
